elsewhere.note: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man had ever sat upon. Untie it and bring…
No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
